final.object: ABNB close-to-close return (%) on the first trading session after the 3Q26 print: close on 6 Nov 2026 / close on 5 Nov 2026 - 1
final.modes: unimodal density, peak near -3, long right shoulder; structure = decelerating-print cells (weight 0.595, model-branch centres -5.5 to -7.8) and accelerating cells (0.32, centres +2.5 to +4.7) with 40% of the mass drawn directionless (half 23-print history kernel, half N(0, 9.0) options normal)

slider_approximation.note: three Gaussians fitted to the final draws; the exact distribution is the draw in datasets/s01_v2_components.json

threshold_probs.tail_note: P(|r| >= 15) 0.125 is heavier than the raw historical count (1 of 23 = 0.043) and than the 9.0-sd normal (0.096), close to the kernel-smoothed history (0.12); deliberate (A06-07)

conditional_base_case.definition: 3Q26 nights print decelerates (< 10.09% y/y under the 0.25pt dead band on 2Q26's 10.34%), the 4Q26 revenue guide midpoint is below the LSEG-family Street mean (C01 = Yes), and the 4Q26 nights descriptor is downgraded from 'low double digits' (C02 options c or d); all three gates generated jointly and applied in code
conditional_base_case.p_decomposition: 0.595 (decel) x 0.761 (C01 below | decel) x 0.792 (C02 c/d | decel & below)

model_branch_only.note: the Z = 1 draws (signal holds) inside the cell; the published conditional is 0.6 x this + 0.4 x directionless, from the same joint draw

two_gate_conditional.note: decel & guide below without the C02 gate; identical table because C02 carries no return coefficient

conditional_base_case.panel_cell: C panel: decel & guide below n 4 (1Q23 -10.9, 1Q24 -6.9, 2Q24 -13.4, 1Q25 +1.0) mean -7.6 raw, median -8.9; with nights-guide direction down (guide_dir_code < 0) n 3 mean -7.8, median -10.9; eligible +10% precedents 0 of 4. Legacy panel 'guide below AND nights lower' n 5 mean -8.0 median -10.9 includes two accelerating prints (3Q22, 3Q23); the C panel's version of that cell is n 6 mean -4.3 median -7.1 because it codes 4Q24 (+14.4) as a decelerating guide (A06-05)
conditional_base_case.revision_1_withdrawn: median -8.6, P(<0) 0.87, P(<=-8) 0.53 at p 0.50: model branch alone, two gates, separate 0.7/0.3 blend (A06-01, A06-02)

conditional_thesis_breaker.definition: accelerating print (>= 10.59%) and 4Q26 guide at or above Street

other_cells.source: datasets/s01_v2_conditionals.csv and s01_v2_cells.csv (twelve joint cells), all from the same draw as the headline

print_state_probabilities.source: print states from R01 (P(>=10.0) 0.42) and R02 (P(>=10.59) 0.32), flat band interpolated; nights within band from R01's calibrated N(9.67, 1.70); guide gap ~ N(-1.85 + 0.32 x (nights - 9.67), 3.1) calibrated to C01 rev 2 (0.72; median $3,100M vs Street $3,161M, sd $97M); C02 gate from C02 rev 2's branch table ((c)+(d) 0.61) with a within-state odds ratio of 2 vs C01 (judgement)

base_rate.derivation: 23 raw day-1 prints, post-2022 prints weighted 2x, Gaussian kernel bw 3pt; DEPENDENT on the decomposition (same prints)

decomposition.derivation: model branch (Z = 1): adopted print states; C01 gap; C02 gate; 0.75 S1 sign rule (mean of n16 and W1 fits) + 0.25 S2 sign+guide-vs-Street; -1.0 positioning term on decel; coefficient N(0, 2.4); residual 0.93 N(0, 6.9) + 0.07 N(0, 14); QQQ N(0, 1.4)

anchor.derivation: options-implied event sd 9.0% (fresh chain 2026-09-17T03:09Z: 16 Oct/20 Nov pair 9.1%, 30 Oct/20 Nov 8.0%, LS 8.2%; B note 12 Sep 9.5%), symmetric normal; risk-neutral, no directional content. Revision 1's two-piece (mode -0.3, downside x1.10; median -1.5, mean -1.7) relabelled a judgement and kept only as a sensitivity (A06-03)

estimates.anchor_source: yfinance ABNB chain pulled 2026-09-17T03:09:19Z (16 Sep close $167.51), sources/yfinance_abnb_chain_20260917T030919Z.csv; 20 Nov $170 straddle 13.0% of spot (bid 12.0 / ask 14.1), 16 Oct $170 straddle 7.4%; no 6 Nov weekly listed yet
estimates.independence_note: The location (median -2.1, P(<0) 0.59) comes from the reaction panel and the adopted print states and is independent of the options market, which prices no direction; the width is deliberately anchored on the options sd because the 23-print rms (8.9), the ex-reopening sd (9.6), the interior sd (9.55) and the implied sd (9.0-9.5) agree. NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_DERIVED applies to the width; the base-rate and decomposition estimates share the same prints and are dependent specifications, so the independent checks are two: the panel's direction and the market's width.

synthesis.structure: one joint draw: r = model(cell) with probability kappa, else directionless (0.5 history kernel / 0.5 options normal); Z independent of the cell so every conditional is kappa x (model | cell) + (1 - kappa) x directionless
synthesis.kappa_reason: above revision 1's effective 0.5 because the pre-stated sign rule survives W1 and W2 (Fisher p 0.007 / 0.008; W2 LOO R2 0.46); below 1 because n 10-16, nothing clears Holm, the guide term fails W2 and the accelerating-bar cell is unobserved
